title: 第657章 入圣大能的人情第656章 激活至宝
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
结界之内，只剩云星落一人。
她望着身前死气沉沉的诸天万符帝册，不再耽搁，指尖轻轻一划。
一滴精纯无比，仙气浓郁的仙灵圣血缓缓滴落，精准落在灰白的帝册封面之上。
轰！
圣血入册，瞬间燃起无尽金光。
原本死寂灰暗，毫无生机的诸天万符帝册，骤然爆发出一道刺破天地的璀璨金芒！
刺眼的金光瞬间冲出结界，书页之上，无数沉寂了上万年的金色大道符文，接连亮起。
一道浩瀚苍茫、古老威严的大帝气息，缓缓弥漫开来。
这是上古神符大帝遗留的道韵，尊贵、霸道、镇压万道。
周遭空间瞬间静止，天地灵气尽数凝滞，连气流都不再流动，整片山谷之内，万符俯首、大道臣服。
原本僵硬死板的书页，开始轻轻自主翻动，每一页翻动，都有万千道纹苏醒，流转生辉、
云星落静静看着，清晰地感知着帝册的变化。
她发现这本诸天万符帝册，果然是符道至高源头，里面记载着无数早已失传的上古帝阶符法、大道符文奥义。
其中许多精妙绝伦的画符手法、符道推演之术，自成一脉、玄妙至极，和她得到的紫霄大帝传承截然不同，相辅相成，让她符道底蕴再度暴涨！
但她神色不动，没有半分外露，只是默默看着帝册彻底复苏。
结界之外，所有神符族弟子看到那熟悉又神圣的金色光芒，瞬间沸腾了。
“是帝册的光芒，我们的镇族之宝复苏了！”
“真的激活了，上万年了，无数先辈穷尽一生都做不到的事，她真的做到了！”
一声声激动的尖叫，欢呼此起彼伏，神符族众人眼眶通红，满心热泪。
最激动的莫过于陆道玄，

他接任族长之位不久，诸天万符帝册便逐年沉寂，灵性散尽，彻底陷入沉睡。
上万年来，他寻遍万法、踏遍整个玄黄界，穷尽一切手段想要唤醒至宝，最终都无功而返。
他早已心生绝望，以为此生再也看不到帝册复苏，以为神符族的至高传承，将永远断绝。
没想到，一名外来的年轻小辈，仅在一炷香的时间，便唤醒了他们一族的希望。
陆道玄身躯微微震颤，眼底满是激动与难以置信，死死盯着结界，一刻也不愿移开目光。
短短一炷香时间转瞬即逝。
结界之内的天地异象缓缓散去，金光内敛，所有大道符文尽数归位。
原本黯淡死寂的诸天万符帝册，此刻通体莹润、金光流转，书页灵动、道韵浩瀚，无数神纹在册页之上缓缓游动，生机勃勃、帝威浩荡。
神符一族镇族之宝，彻底复苏，圆满激活。
云星落抬手收起帝册，撤去自身气息，缓步走出结界。
她将灵性十足的诸天万符帝册递还给陆道玄，语气平淡从容：“陆族长，不负所托，至宝已然彻底激活，你可以亲自查验。”
陆道玄连忙伸手接过帝册，指尖微微颤抖，迫不及待注入自身灵力。
content_en:
Within the barrier, only Yun Xingluo was left.
She looked at the lifeless Emperor's Book of All Heavens and Ten Thousand Talisman in front of her, and without further delay, she lightly drew with her fingertips.
A drop of extremely pure, fairy-like holy blood slowly dripped down and landed precisely on the gray-white cover of the Emperor's Book.
boom!
The holy blood was entered into the book, and endless golden light instantly ignited.
The originally dead, gray and lifeless Emperor's Book of Ten Thousand Talisman of the Heavens suddenly erupted into a bright golden light that pierced the heaven and earth!
The dazzling golden light burst out of the barrier instantly, and on the pages of the book, countless golden avenue runes that had been silent for tens of thousands of years lit up one after another.
A vast, ancient and majestic aura of the emperor slowly filled the air.
This is the Taoist charm left by the ancient Divine Talisman Emperor, who is noble, domineering, and suppresses all Taoism.
The surrounding space instantly stopped, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was all stagnant, and even the air flow stopped flowing. In the entire valley, all the symbols bowed their heads and the avenue surrendered.
The pages of the book, which were originally stiff and rigid, began to turn gently and independently. Every time the page was turned, thousands of lines came to life, flowing and shining.
Yun Xingluo watched quietly, clearly sensing the changes in the emperor's register.
She discovered that this Emperor's Book of Ten Thousand Talisman of the Heavens was indeed the supreme source of Talismanism. It contained countless long-lost ancient Talisman spells and the mysteries of the Great Dao runes.
Many of the exquisite talisman painting techniques and talisman Tao deduction techniques are unique and extremely mysterious. They are completely different from the inheritance she received from Emperor Zixiao. They complement each other and make her talisman Tao foundation skyrocket again!
But her expression remained motionless, not revealing at all, and she just watched silently as the emperor's book recovered completely.
Outside the barrier, all the disciples of the Divine Rune Tribe boiled up instantly when they saw the familiar and sacred golden light.
"It's the light of the Emperor's Book, and our clan's treasure has revived!"
"It's really activated. For tens of thousands of years, she really did what countless ancestors couldn't do in their entire lives!"
There were excited screams and cheers one after another. The eyes of everyone in the Shenfu tribe were red and their hearts were filled with tears.
The most excited person is Lu Daoxuan.
Not long after he took over the position of clan leader, the Emperor's Book of All Heavens and Ten Thousand Talisman became silent year by year, his spirituality disappeared, and he fell into a deep sleep.
For tens of thousands of years, he has searched for thousands of methods, traveled throughout the Xuanhuang Realm, and exhausted all means to awaken the treasure, but ultimately failed.
He had already despaired, thinking that he would never see the revival of the Emperor's Book in this life, thinking that the supreme inheritance of the Shenfu Clan would be cut off forever.
Unexpectedly, a young outsider awakened the hope of their clan with just one stick of incense.
Lu Daoxuan's body trembled slightly, his eyes full of excitement and disbelief, staring at the barrier, unwilling to look away for a moment.
Time flies by in just one stick of incense.
The strange phenomena of heaven and earth within the barrier slowly dissipated, the golden light was restrained, and all the runes of the avenue returned to their positions.
The originally dim and dead Emperor's Book of Ten Thousand Talisman of the Heavens is now full of luster, with golden light flowing around it. The pages are agile and have a vast Taoist rhyme. Countless divine patterns are slowly swimming on the pages, full of vitality and majestic imperial power.
The treasure of the Talisman clan, which is the clan's treasure, has been completely revived and fully activated.
Yun Xingluo raised his hand to put away the imperial book, removed his own aura, and walked out of the barrier slowly.
She handed back the spiritual Emperor's Book of Ten Thousand Talisman of All Heavens to Lu Daoxuan and said in a calm and calm tone: "Clan Chief Lu, you have lived up to your trust. The treasure has been fully activated. You can check it yourself."
Lu Daoxuan quickly stretched out his hand to take the imperial book, his fingertips trembling slightly, eager to inject his own spiritual power.
